results.text: Pharmacokinetics of phenobarbitone in protein energy malnutrition. Phenobarbitone kinetics was studied in malnourished and normal children after single oral dose of approximately 7.0 mg/kg. Estimation of serum phenobarbitone concentration was performed by spectrophotometric method. Elimination half-life was 58.9 +/- 9.5 h and 30.15 +/- 6.1 h for malnourished and healthy children, respectively.
